ios.desc:
In 2024, Oxford made “brain rot” the word of the year. The term means long, mindless scrolling on social media.
But are social media really that bad? They still help us work, connect, and study. 

We believe the key is balance. Taskfulness helps you keep valuable interactions while limiting the doomscrolling. 
The results: our members save 28-36% of their screen time daily, without missing out. 
Want intentional screen time? Try Taskfulness free for 7 days. 

Built on Cognitive Behaviour Therapy principles.    


HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick an app  
Select the apps that steal most of your time. For example, Instagram, WhatsApp, Reddit, Gmail, etc.
2. Set intention  
Each time you open a chosen app, Taskfulness will pop up and ask: “Why do you need it?” and “For how long?”. Once you enter the reason, the app opens.
3. Stay focused*  
Use the app for the duration you set. Mid-session, you’ll get a quick reminder of your original intention. When time’s up, the app closes automatically.  
*works only with Reminders on 


WHY TASKFULNESS 

- No deleting accounts: Use social media intentionally.
- Saves time: Our users reclaim an average of 28-36% or 14 hours of screen time per week.
- Strong against procrastination: Combats reactiveness, time blindness, and distractions.
- Built with expertise: Created by founders with ADHD, based on CBT, and approved by psychologists for effectiveness and safety.

Let’s make your screen time short and focused!
Taskfulness team.
